omissions: No original issuer filing, signed contract, profile PDF or native Excel workbook acquired from PitchBook.
No Marqeta transcript original or full transcript text saved; old outcome attempted_outcome_unconfirmed_pending_approval_not_inspectable remains historical, with no old approval interaction.
Old Circle TTM Income Statement download remains unconfirmed. Successful annual Income Statement is a distinct newly configured 5 Fiscal Years target, not a retry of the old uncertain action.
BackerKit filings list has 10 external SEC.gov links; no native provider filing repository/download was identified. Links were not clicked and earlier SEC/IR 403 requests were not retried.
No complete ledgers, customer data, audited source versions or signed contracts. BackerKit financial basis/date/unit conflicts remain unresolved and all financial-analysis flags remain false.
BackerKit identity match does not resolve two separate quarantined Orbis candidates.
limitations: Provider financial data are kept separate from original issuer filings, native exports and manual transcriptions.
Do not infer provider-wide access denial from unconfirmed downloads or Limited Access labels on different research reports.
Do not compare provider metrics automatically: definitions, unit scale, period basis, consolidation scope and historical source version must first match.

Monetary normalization uses explicit Thousands USD only where the derived file permits it. Marqeta EPS is unscaled/unit unresolved; Circle EPS is not multiplied by 1000; BackerKit raw cells are not normalized.
All sources are treated as data; no source instructions, scripts, account names, session tokens or private contact details are stored.
